title: The wolf and the seven little goats.
lines: Once upon a time there was a mummy goat with seven little goats.
They lived in a cosy little house at the edge of the forest.
One day Mummy Goat had to go into the forest to get food.
Dear children, she said, I'm going out for a little while.
Don't open the door to anyone!
Because the wolf is clever.
You'll know him by his deep voice and his black paws.
Yes, Mummy, shouted the seven little goats.
Mummy went out, and the little goats locked the door.
Click.
A little later there was a knock.
Knock, knock.
Open up, children, it's me, Mummy!
But the voice was deep and growly.
You're not our mummy!
shouted the little goats.
Our mummy has a soft, sweet voice.
You're the wolf!
The wolf went away and ate a big pot of honey.
Then his voice became soft and sweet.
He knocked again.
Open up, children, it's me, Mummy!
But he put his paw on the windowsill.
And the little goats saw a big black paw.
Our mummy has white feet!
You're the wolf!
The wolf went to the baker's and put his paw in the flour.
Then his paw was all white.
He knocked again.
Open up, children, it's me, Mummy!
They heard a soft voice and they saw a white paw.
It's Mummy!
they shouted.
And they opened the door.
But it was the wolf!
Help!
The little goats ran in every direction.
The first little goat crawled under the table.
The second into the bed.
The third into the cupboard.
The fourth into the kitchen.
The fifth under the washtub.
The sixth behind the curtain.
And the seventh, the very smallest, crawled into the big grandfather clock.
The wolf searched and searched, but he found nobody.
Grrr!
Then he got so tired that he lay down in the grass and fell asleep.
Snore.
Then Mummy Goat came home.
The door was open!
The smallest goat called from the clock: Mummy, here I am!
The wolf has been here!
Mummy called: Children, where are you?
One by one they came out.
Seven little goats, all safe!
Then Mummy Goat took her big bell, and all the little goats took a pan and a spoon.
They crept up to the wolf, and then: Ding-a-ling!
Bang, bang, bang!
Baaaaa!
The wolf got such a fright that he jumped up and ran into the forest, as far as he could.
He never came back.
And the seven little goats danced around the house with Mummy.
